entries.english:
Photo album with family pictures of the von Tiedemann family, relatives and ancestors, partly cross-referenced to pedigree numbers (mostly copies; originals removed to picture collection R 4).

Contains: Käthe Maertens, married von Tiedemann, 1912 (R 4 no. 38332), and husband Hans von Tiedemann, reserve cavalry captain at Russoschin, 1912 (no. 38333); Frieda von Tiedemann, Hans’s sister, 1916 (nos. 38334–38335); Dietrich von Tiedemann (no. 38336); Friederike Maertens, née Selz (no. 38337), and husband Georg Maertens (no. 38338); Ida Knaake, née Selz (no. 38339), and husband Prof. Dr. Emil Knaake in Tilsit, East Prussia (no. 38340); Georg Maertens and his father Georg Maertens, Prussian Amtsrat (nos. 38341–38342); Leo von Tiedemann, second lieutenant in the Kaiser Franz Guards Regiment (no. 38343); Louise Christiane von Tiedemann, née von Hardt (1851–1930) (no. 38344), husband Erich Werner Ludwig Erdmann von Tiedemann (no. 38345), their estate Kranz in Pomerania (no. 38346), daughter Johanna von Einem, née von Tiedemann (no. 38347), her husband Ernst von Einem, Prussian cavalry captain (no. 38348), and their estate at Schmölln, Züllichau district (no. 38349); Franz Wilhelm von Tiedemann-Brandis, Prussian royal chamberlain (no. 38350), and wife Marianne Helene Dorothea Auguste von Tiedemann, née Gräfin zu Dohna-Schlobitten (no. 38451); Richard von Tiedemann (no. 38352) and parents Dorothea von Tiedemann, née von Hardt (no. 38353), and Heinrich von Tiedemann; Margarete Klementine Elisabeth von Stuckrad, née von Tiedemann (no. 38354), and Margarethe with Luise Margarethe Julie Erdmuthe Gräfin Rothkirch Freifrau von Trach, née von Tiedemann (no. 38355); Marie von Tiedemann, née von Stuckrad (no. 38356); Carl Ludwig von Tiedemann-Brandis, lord of Prangschin and Woyanow (no. 38357); Reinhard von Tiedemann-Brandis, Prussian royal cavalry captain (no. 38358), and brother Siegfried von Tiedemann-Brandis, Prussian royal major and chamberlain (no. 38359); Franz Gerhard von Tiedemann-Brandis, Prussian royal captain (retired) at Prangschin and Woyanow (no. 38360); Marie Helene Dorothea Auguste von Tiedemann, née Gräfin zu Dohna-Schlobitten (no. 38361), and husband Franz Wilhelm von Tiedemann-Brandis at Prangschin and Woyanow (no. 38362); Albrecht von Tiedemann (no. 38363), daughter Esther van Krose Vinkhaven, née von Tiedemann (no. 38364), and her estate Klein-Linichen in Pomerania (no. 38365); Eberhard Wexel, major and battalion commander (no. 38366), and wife Irene Wexel, née von Tiedemann (no. 38367); Alexandrine von Tiedemann, née von Selchow (nos. 38368–38369); Leo von Tiedemann, commander of the 1st Life Hussar Regiment in Danzig-Langfuhr, with son Rüdiger von Tiedemann (no. 38370), daughter Eva von Gerlach, née von Tiedemann (no. 38371), and daughter-in-law Emmy von Tiedemann, née Fretwell, with son Hermann von Tiedemann (no. 38372); Leo von Tiedemann (nos. 38373–38374) and wife Elisabeth (Elise) von Tiedemann, née von Sanden (no. 38375); Lauchlan MacLean and wife Helene MacLean, née von Tiedemann (nos. 38376–38377); Martin von Gerlach and sister Wolfine von Rosenberg Gruczynski, née von Gerlach (no. 38378); sisters Helene MacLean, née von Tiedemann, Elisabeth (Elise) Charlotte Bertha Eva Thomas, née von Tiedemann, and Eva von Gerlach, née von Tiedemann, and sister-in-law Wolfine von Rosenberg-Gruczynski, née von Gerlach (no. 38379); Hermann von Tiedemann, lieutenant in Thuringian Infantry Regiment No. 95 (no. 38380); Rosalie von Tiedemann (no. 38381); Agathe von Tiedemann, pianist and accompanist to Wilhelm Furtwängler (no. 38382); Ursula (Ulla) Gräfin von Pfeil, née von Tiedemann (no. 38383); Marie von Heyden Gräfin Kartlow, née von Tiedemann (no. 38384), husband Adam Werner von Heyden Graf von Kartlow (no. 38385), their son Jürgen Adam von Heyden Graf von Kartlow (no. 38386), his wife Agnes Anna, née Wagner, and sons Waldemar and Jürgen (no. 38387), and Kartlow Castle in Pomerania (nos. 38388/1–2); Carl Ludwig Heinrich von Tiedemann, Imperial Russian general staff lieutenant colonel in Riga, and wife Rosalie Constantia von Tiedemann, née von Tiedemann (no. 38289); Alexander Leopold Ernst Graf von Kanitz-Podangen (no. 38391) and wife Emilie, née von Tiedemann (no. 38390); Henriette Louise Charlotte von Tiedemann, née von Calbo (no. 38392); Ludwig Ferdinand von Tiedemann, Polish royal major at Russoschin (no. 38393); Curt Christoph Graf von Schwerin (no. 38394); Maria Prinzessin von Hohenzollern-Hechingen (no. 38395); Georg Giese, merchant in Danzig (no. 38396); Johann Schwarzwald, merchant in Danzig at the London Hanseatic office (no. 38397); Friedrich Wilhelm von Selchow (no. 38398) and wife Friederike Ludowika Amalie, née Kummer (no. 38399); Bogislav von Selchow, writer, naval officer and leader of the Marburg student corps (no. 38400); Johann Heinrich Christian von Selchow, professor of law in Marburg (no. 38401); Eleonore Friederike Erdmuthe Kummer, née von Natzmer (no. 38402), and husband Georg Daniel Kummer (no. 38403); Malise MacLean, second clan chief (no. 38404), and Castle MacLean on the Isle of Col (also no. 38404); Sir Fitzroy Donald MacLean, colonel and clan chief (no. 38405), and Castle MacLean on the Isle of Col, Scotland (no. 38406); John Simpson, mayor of Memel (no. 38407), and wife Dorothea Simpson, née Douglas (also no. 38407); Archibald MacLean (no. 38409) and wife Mary MacLean, née Simpson (no. 38410); Marianne Angelika MacLean, née von Almonde (no. 38411); Püstow manor house in Pomerania, residence of Franz von Zitzewitz and Alexandrine Elise Auguste Erdmuthe (Adda) von Zitzewitz, née von Tiedemann (no. 38412); Archibald MacLean IV and Archibald MacLean V (no. 38413); Lauchlan MacLean I (no. 38414) and wife Marie Dorothea MacLean, widow MacLean, née Beerbohm (no. 38415); Lauchlan MacLean II (no. 38416); Carl von Tiedemann and wife Marie, née von Puttkamer (no. 38417); Carl von Tiedemann, lieutenant general, and wife Irmgard Minna Marga Auguste Georgine Julie von Tiedemann, née Tschirschnitz (no. 38418); Joachim von Tiedemann, son of Carl von Tiedemann, presenting flowers to General Field Marshal Paul von Hindenburg (no. 38419); Carl von Tiedemann with son Joachim and Colonel General August Wilhelm Heye (no. 38420); Paul von Hindenburg inspecting the front with Carl von Tiedemann (no. 38421); and the Woyanow estate of the von Tiedemann-Brandis family (no. 38422 UF).
